d.seg: बता सकते हो आप एक्चुअली मै व्हाट्सएप पे वीडियो कॉलस वगैरह करती हूँ चार्जस लेके आपका
d.tr: Can you tell me, actually, I do video calls on WhatsApp with charges?
d.j: The user is indirectly referencing charging for video calls, which suggests a transactional nature related to the service.

d.seg: ओपन वीडियो कॉल्स वगैरह करती हूँ चार्जेस लेके आप करोगे
d.tr: I do open video calls with charges, will you do it?
d.j: The user is directly asking if the other party will engage in paid open video calls.

d.seg: आप तो कितने रुपए लेती हो
d.tr: How many rupees do you take?
d.j: The user is directly asking about the rate for the service being provided.
